pages.text: Load the chair with a $(item)Life Support Jar$(), $(item)Relay Goggles$(), a $(item)Collar Cam$() and four bottles of $(item)Cranial Saline$(), and give it 40 kFE. Sit down and hold $(l)Sign$() on Form 27-B.
You may get up until the cut. After that, DOLORES will finish what she started. A worn blade can botch the job: keep a $(item)Replacement Blade$() handy.
